lines.zh: 帆一样的背脊，从芦苇上露出来
lines.en: My sail-backed spine rises above the reeds

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥陷到脚踝，我照样走
lines.en: The swamp mud sinks to my ankle, and I walk on

lines.zh: 我踩着水，水花往两边开
lines.en: I tread the water and it parts on both sides
My long snout hangs near the water
The mangrove roots do not trip me
I wade through the shallows step by step

lines.zh: 尾巴在水里划出一道线
lines.en: My tail draws a line through the water
Mud squeezes up between my claws

lines.zh: 这么大的身子，走起来很慢
lines.en: A body this size moves slowly
The reeds go down where I lean

lines.zh: 我沿着河湾走，那里有鱼
lines.en: I walk along the bend, there are fish there
The water covers the sound of my steps
Weeds hang from my sail

lines.zh: 我在沼泽里走，没人看得见
lines.en: I move through the swamp unseen

lines.zh: 我闻到了腥味，就在前面
lines.en: I smell something fishy, just ahead

lines.zh: 我低头，水面映着我的影子
lines.en: I look down and the water holds my shadow

lines.zh: 我站在浅水里，一动不动
lines.en: I stand in the shallows, motionless

lines.zh: 水面很静，只有我的呼吸
lines.en: The water is still, only my breathing moves

lines.zh: 我的背帆慢慢转着方向
lines.en: My sail slowly turns with the sun
My jaws part slightly, waiting

lines.zh: 沼泽里虫子很多，我不理
lines.en: The swamp is full of insects, I ignore them

lines.zh: 我听见远处有东西落水
lines.en: I hear something fall into the water far off
Weeds wrap around my feet

lines.zh: 我这身子的影子在水底
lines.en: My shadow lies on the bottom
I lift my head and check the bank

lines.zh: 这么站着，很像一截木头
lines.en: Standing like this, I look like a log

lines.zh: 水面有波纹过来，我知道有东西
lines.en: Ripples come toward me, something is there

lines.zh: 我等，水里的东西总会来
lines.en: I wait, the water always brings something
My sail is warm in the sun

lines.zh: 我的鼻孔在水面上，只露出这一点
lines.en: Only my nostrils break the surface
You stand on the bank looking into the water

lines.zh: 我把头转过来，长嘴对着你
lines.en: I turn my head, my long snout at you

lines.zh: 我比你高很多，你不用怀疑
lines.en: I am much taller than you, have no doubt

lines.zh: 这片沼泽，我在这儿吃东西
lines.en: This swamp is where I feed
I have walked the mud under your feet

lines.zh: 我的牙长得不整齐，可够用
lines.en: My teeth are uneven, but they work
Do not back into the water
When I move, the water spreads

lines.zh: 我在看你身上有没有鱼腥味
lines.en: I am checking you for the smell of fish
Do not put your hand near the water
My hide is thick, and it still hurts
I ease back and the shallows splash
That one cut across my back
I growl, very low
I shake my head and water flies high
My sail shivered
This wound will not stop me feeding

lines.zh: 这一下我记进骨头里了
lines.en: I have taken that one into the bone
I grit my teeth, all of them showing
I lower my head and come closer
That is not one mouthful for me
I sniff it, it is dead already
Your hand is too far from the water
I open my mouth, you had better step back
I catch my own in the water
Drop it down here
That one is too small to bother with
I sniff it and turn away

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，像撞树根
lines.en: You hit my leg like hitting a root
My foot slipped in the mud and I held
Do not stand by my jaws

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，水溅了你一身
lines.en: I shake my head and water sprays over you

lines.zh: 这一下，你没被踩到算运气
lines.en: You are lucky not to be stepped on

lines.zh: 我退了半步，水响了一下
lines.en: I step back and the water sounds
My tail caught you

lines.zh: 沼泽里就这么宽，你躲不开
lines.en: The swamp is only so wide, you cannot dodge

lines.zh: 我的皮很硬，你的手会疼
lines.en: My hide is hard, your hand will hurt
Come closer and I take you for food

lines.zh: 这一片沼泽，只有我一个
lines.en: I am the only one in this swamp
The mangroves are too dense to move through
This sail of mine is meant to be seen
No answer comes from the water

lines.zh: 河湾里没有同类回应我的低鸣。
lines.en: No kin answers my low call across the river bend.
The season is wrong
You are standing too far off

lines.zh: 我的牙只用来吃，不用来说
lines.en: My teeth are for eating, not for talking
Perhaps there is one at the bend
I will walk over and see
I lower my head and the snout goes into the water
I take it up in my teeth
So small, one bite would crush it
This is not a fish
It has no taste in my mouth
I pin it with a foot and look down
It slipped between my teeth
I stare at the bright spot on the bottom

lines.zh: 泥一起翻上来，看不见了
lines.en: The mud churns up and it is gone
A shadow moved on the water

lines.zh: 我抬起头，水从嘴里淌下来
lines.en: I lift my head and water runs from my jaws
You stand on the bank, too close to the water
I swing my tail once, ready to move
This swamp is mine
I smell you, quite fresh

lines.zh: 我往岸边走，水越来越浅
lines.en: I head for the bank, the water thinning
The way you are backing is wrong

lines.zh: 我的脚陷进泥里，又拔出来
lines.en: My foot sinks in the mud and pulls free
The reeds hide half of me
Linger a moment more and I arrive

lines.zh: 我想起你刚才在水边的样子
lines.en: I recall how you looked by the water
I follow along the water's edge
You cannot run fast on mud
My snout can reach a long way
Run for the trees, it is worse there
I go step by step, each one planted

lines.zh: 水被我一搅，什么都看不清
lines.en: I churn the water and nothing can be seen
You looked back, and slowed
I need not run, my reach is enough
There is no high ground here

lines.zh: 我的背帆在你身后挡住了光
lines.en: My sail blocks the light behind you
Your breathing is getting short
The mud will drag at your feet
The long jaws snap shut on you
My foreclaw rakes your shoulder

lines.zh: 这一下，把你扫进了水里
lines.en: That swept you into the water

lines.zh: 我抬脚踩下去，泥都溅起来
lines.en: I bring a foot down and mud sprays up
You are flung into the reeds
The teeth are short, the bite is not
I swing my head and you lose your grip
My strength is greater in the water

lines.zh: 你退到岸边，我跟着上来
lines.en: You back to the bank, and I come up after
At that charge your bones creak
A sail rises out of the swamp
I rear up out of the reeds
The water muddied, then I surfaced

lines.zh: 这里的泥地上多了大脚印
lines.en: Big prints have appeared in the mud
My long snout breaks the surface first
A shape has appeared among the mangroves
I walk step by step into the shallows
A ring of ripples spread across the water
I stand in the middle of this swamp
The birds on the bank have all gone

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，试了试咬合
lines.en: I open my jaws and test the bite
Something this size cannot hide
The reeds fall aside in swathes

lines.zh: 火烧到我的帆上，焦味很重
lines.en: Fire caught my sail, the stench is heavy

lines.zh: 我从岸上滑下去，摔进水里
lines.en: I slid off the bank and crashed into the water

lines.zh: 水太深了，我这身子浮不起来
lines.en: The water is too deep, I cannot float
The blast set the whole surface shaking
An arrow is stuck in my sail

lines.zh: 那股劲儿钻进骨头，很凉
lines.en: That force worked into my bones, cold

lines.zh: 这片水里没鱼了，我饿得慌
lines.en: No fish left in this water, I am starving

lines.zh: 雷落在我背上，我半边身子麻了
lines.en: Lightning struck my back and half of me went numb
No water here, and no mud
